scene.label: Act 4, Scene 7
scene.title: SCENE VII. A Tent in the French Camp
scene.location: A Tent in the French Camp

content.text: Lear on a bed, asleep, soft music playing; Physician, Gentleman and others attending.

lines.text: O thou good Kent, how shall I live and work
lines.plainText: O thou good Kent how shall I live and work

lines.text: To match thy goodness? My life will be too short,
lines.plainText: To match thy goodness My life will be too short

lines.text: And every measure fail me.
lines.plainText: And every measure fail me

lines.text: To be acknowledg'd, madam, is o'erpaid.
lines.plainText: To be acknowledg'd madam is o'erpaid

lines.text: All my reports go with the modest truth;
lines.plainText: All my reports go with the modest truth

lines.text: Nor more, nor clipp'd, but so.
lines.plainText: Nor more nor clipp'd but so

lines.text: Be better suited,
lines.plainText: Be better suited

lines.text: These weeds are memories of those worser hours:
lines.plainText: These weeds are memories of those worser hours

lines.text: I prithee put them off.
lines.plainText: I prithee put them off

lines.text: Pardon, dear madam;
lines.plainText: Pardon dear madam

lines.text: Yet to be known shortens my made intent.
lines.plainText: Yet to be known shortens my made intent

lines.text: My boon I make it that you know me not
lines.plainText: My boon I make it that you know me not

lines.text: Till time and I think meet.
lines.plainText: Till time and I think meet

lines.text: Then be't so, my good lord. [To the Physician.] How does the King?
lines.plainText: Then be't so my good lord To the Physician How does the King

lines.text: Madam, sleeps still.
lines.plainText: Madam sleeps still

lines.text: O you kind gods,
lines.plainText: O you kind gods

lines.text: Cure this great breach in his abused nature!
lines.plainText: Cure this great breach in his abused nature

lines.text: The untun'd and jarring senses, O, wind up
lines.plainText: The untun'd and jarring senses O wind up

lines.text: Of this child-changed father.
lines.plainText: Of this childchanged father

lines.text: So please your majesty
lines.plainText: So please your majesty

lines.text: That we may wake the King: he hath slept long.
lines.plainText: That we may wake the King he hath slept long

lines.text: Be govern'd by your knowledge, and proceed
lines.plainText: Be govern'd by your knowledge and proceed

lines.text: I' the sway of your own will. Is he array'd?
lines.plainText: I' the sway of your own will Is he array'd

lines.text: Ay, madam. In the heaviness of sleep
lines.plainText: Ay madam In the heaviness of sleep

lines.text: We put fresh garments on him.
lines.plainText: We put fresh garments on him

lines.text: Be by, good madam, when we do awake him;
lines.plainText: Be by good madam when we do awake him

lines.text: I doubt not of his temperance.
lines.plainText: I doubt not of his temperance

lines.text: Very well.
lines.plainText: Very well

lines.text: Please you draw near. Louder the music there!
lines.plainText: Please you draw near Louder the music there

lines.text: O my dear father! Restoration hang
lines.plainText: O my dear father Restoration hang

lines.text: Thy medicine on my lips; and let this kiss
lines.plainText: Thy medicine on my lips and let this kiss

lines.text: Repair those violent harms that my two sisters
lines.plainText: Repair those violent harms that my two sisters

lines.text: Have in thy reverence made!
lines.plainText: Have in thy reverence made

lines.text: Kind and dear princess!
lines.plainText: Kind and dear princess

lines.text: Had you not been their father, these white flakes
lines.plainText: Had you not been their father these white flakes

lines.text: Did challenge pity of them. Was this a face
lines.plainText: Did challenge pity of them Was this a face

lines.text: To be oppos'd against the warring winds?
lines.plainText: To be oppos'd against the warring winds

lines.text: To stand against the deep dread-bolted thunder?
lines.plainText: To stand against the deep dreadbolted thunder

lines.text: In the most terrible and nimble stroke
lines.plainText: In the most terrible and nimble stroke

lines.text: Of quick cross lightning? to watch, poor perdu!
lines.plainText: Of quick cross lightning to watch poor perdu

lines.text: With this thin helm? Mine enemy's dog,
lines.plainText: With this thin helm Mine enemy's dog

lines.text: Though he had bit me, should have stood that night
lines.plainText: Though he had bit me should have stood that night

lines.text: Against my fire; and wast thou fain, poor father,
lines.plainText: Against my fire and wast thou fain poor father

lines.text: To hovel thee with swine and rogues forlorn
lines.plainText: To hovel thee with swine and rogues forlorn

lines.text: In short and musty straw? Alack, alack!
lines.plainText: In short and musty straw Alack alack

lines.text: 'Tis wonder that thy life and wits at once
lines.plainText: 'Tis wonder that thy life and wits at once

lines.text: Had not concluded all. He wakes; speak to him.
lines.plainText: Had not concluded all He wakes speak to him

lines.text: Madam, do you; 'tis fittest.
lines.plainText: Madam do you 'tis fittest

lines.text: How does my royal lord? How fares your majesty?
lines.plainText: How does my royal lord How fares your majesty

lines.text: You do me wrong to take me out o' the grave.
lines.plainText: You do me wrong to take me out o' the grave

lines.text: Thou art a soul in bliss; but I am bound
lines.plainText: Thou art a soul in bliss but I am bound

lines.text: Upon a wheel of fire, that mine own tears
lines.plainText: Upon a wheel of fire that mine own tears

lines.text: Do scald like molten lead.
lines.plainText: Do scald like molten lead

lines.text: Sir, do you know me?
lines.plainText: Sir do you know me

lines.text: You are a spirit, I know: when did you die?
lines.plainText: You are a spirit I know when did you die

lines.text: Still, still, far wide!
lines.plainText: Still still far wide

lines.text: He's scarce awake: let him alone awhile.
lines.plainText: He's scarce awake let him alone awhile

lines.text: Where have I been? Where am I? Fair daylight?
lines.plainText: Where have I been Where am I Fair daylight

lines.text: I am mightily abus'd. I should e'en die with pity,
lines.plainText: I am mightily abus'd I should e'en die with pity

lines.text: To see another thus. I know not what to say.
lines.plainText: To see another thus I know not what to say

lines.text: I will not swear these are my hands: let's see;
lines.plainText: I will not swear these are my hands let's see

lines.text: I feel this pin prick. Would I were assur'd
lines.plainText: I feel this pin prick Would I were assur'd

lines.text: Of my condition!
lines.plainText: Of my condition

lines.text: O, look upon me, sir,
lines.plainText: O look upon me sir

lines.text: And hold your hands in benediction o'er me.
lines.plainText: And hold your hands in benediction o'er me

lines.text: No, sir, you must not kneel.
lines.plainText: No sir you must not kneel

lines.text: Pray, do not mock me:
lines.plainText: Pray do not mock me

lines.text: I am a very foolish fond old man,
lines.plainText: I am a very foolish fond old man

lines.text: Fourscore and upward, not an hour more nor less;
lines.plainText: Fourscore and upward not an hour more nor less

lines.text: And to deal plainly,
lines.plainText: And to deal plainly

lines.text: I fear I am not in my perfect mind.
lines.plainText: I fear I am not in my perfect mind

lines.text: Methinks I should know you, and know this man;
lines.plainText: Methinks I should know you and know this man

lines.text: Yet I am doubtful: for I am mainly ignorant
lines.plainText: Yet I am doubtful for I am mainly ignorant

lines.text: What place this is; and all the skill I have
lines.plainText: What place this is and all the skill I have

lines.text: Remembers not these garments; nor I know not
lines.plainText: Remembers not these garments nor I know not

lines.text: Where I did lodge last night. Do not laugh at me;
lines.plainText: Where I did lodge last night Do not laugh at me

lines.text: For, as I am a man, I think this lady
lines.plainText: For as I am a man I think this lady

lines.text: To be my child Cordelia.
lines.plainText: To be my child Cordelia

lines.text: And so I am. I am.
lines.plainText: And so I am I am

lines.text: Be your tears wet? Yes, faith. I pray weep not:
lines.plainText: Be your tears wet Yes faith I pray weep not

lines.text: If you have poison for me, I will drink it.
lines.plainText: If you have poison for me I will drink it

lines.text: I know you do not love me; for your sisters
lines.plainText: I know you do not love me for your sisters

lines.text: Have, as I do remember, done me wrong.
lines.plainText: Have as I do remember done me wrong

lines.text: You have some cause, they have not.
lines.plainText: You have some cause they have not

lines.text: No cause, no cause.
lines.plainText: No cause no cause

lines.text: Am I in France?
lines.plainText: Am I in France

lines.text: In your own kingdom, sir.
lines.plainText: In your own kingdom sir

lines.text: Do not abuse me.
lines.plainText: Do not abuse me

lines.text: Be comforted, good madam, the great rage,
lines.plainText: Be comforted good madam the great rage

lines.text: You see, is kill'd in him: and yet it is danger
lines.plainText: You see is kill'd in him and yet it is danger

lines.text: To make him even o'er the time he has lost.
lines.plainText: To make him even o'er the time he has lost

lines.text: Desire him to go in; trouble him no more
lines.plainText: Desire him to go in trouble him no more

lines.text: Till further settling.
lines.plainText: Till further settling

lines.text: Will't please your highness walk?
lines.plainText: Will't please your highness walk

lines.text: You must bear with me:
lines.plainText: You must bear with me

lines.text: Pray you now, forget and forgive: I am old and foolish.
lines.plainText: Pray you now forget and forgive I am old and foolish

lines.text: Holds it true, sir, that the Duke of Cornwall was so slain?
lines.plainText: Holds it true sir that the Duke of Cornwall was so slain

lines.text: Most certain, sir.
lines.plainText: Most certain sir

lines.text: Who is conductor of his people?
lines.plainText: Who is conductor of his people

lines.text: As 'tis said, the bastard son of Gloucester.
lines.plainText: As 'tis said the bastard son of Gloucester

lines.text: They say Edgar, his banished son, is with the Earl of Kent in Germany.
lines.plainText: They say Edgar his banished son is with the Earl of Kent in Germany

lines.text: Report is changeable. 'Tis time to look about; the powers of the kingdom approach apace.
lines.plainText: Report is changeable 'Tis time to look about the powers of the kingdom approach apace

lines.text: The arbitrement is like to be bloody.
lines.plainText: The arbitrement is like to be bloody

lines.text: Fare you well, sir.
lines.plainText: Fare you well sir

lines.text: My point and period will be throughly wrought,
lines.plainText: My point and period will be throughly wrought

lines.text: Or well or ill, as this day's battle's fought.
lines.plainText: Or well or ill as this day's battle's fought
